preconditions.description: The total number of nodes n must be between 3 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of exit-nodes k must be between 2 and n-1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of wires must be exactly n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in wires)
postconditions.description: Each wire must connect two nodes with ids between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(set(u for u, v in wires) | set(v for u, v in wires)) == n
postconditions.description: All nodes must be included in the network.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for u, v in wires if u == exit_node or v == exit_node) == 1 for exit_node in exit_nodes
postconditions.description: Each exit-node must be connected to exactly one other node.

postconditions.expression: all(len(neighbors) >= 2 for node, neighbors in adjacency_list.items() if node not in exit_nodes)
postconditions.description: All non-exit-nodes must be connected to at least two nodes.

postconditions.expression: max_distance == max(bfs_distance(exit_node1, exit_node2) for exit_node1, exit_node2 in combinations(exit_nodes, 2))
postconditions.description: The output distance must be the maximum distance between any two exit-nodes.
